# Paranjape Blue Ridge Complete Township & Architectural Blueprint
> Canonical Source: https://paranjapeblueridge.com

## Official Township Specifications & Engineering Standards
1. Structure: Cast-in-place monolithic MiVAN aluminum formwork concrete structure ensuring maximum seismic stability, smooth wall finishes, and zero column dead space.
2. Flooring & Surfaces:
   - Living, Dining, Bedrooms, Kitchen & Passages: Polished glazed vitrified tiles (PGVT).
   - Sit-out Balconies & Terraces: Glazed vitrified anti-skid tiles.
   - Bathrooms: Designer vitrified tiles with full-body vitrified vanity counters and toughened glass shower partitions.
3. Kitchen & Utility Platform:
   - Full-body vitrified tile platform with single bowl stainless steel sink (SS Sink).
   - Modular layout chimney exhaust provisions.
   - Reticulated piped LPG gas supply with automatic safety shut-off valves.
4. Joinery, Doors & Windows:
   - Main Entrance Door: Premium flush door shutter and frame with dual-side laminate and digital security lock.
   - Bedroom & Bathroom Doors: Pre-hung flush door shutters and frames with dual-side laminate.
   - Windows: Heavy-gauge anodized aluminum sliding windows and balcony doors with integrated mosquito nets.

## Key Architectural Highlights
- Grand Double-Height Entrance Lobbies with executive reception and card/biometric access.
- 3-Side Open Architectural Floor Layout for uninterrupted natural lighting and cross-ventilation.
- Two Walk-In Wardrobes in Master Bedroom Suites.
- Golf & River-Facing Balconies with panoramic vistas across the Mula River corridor.
- 4-Tier Perimeter Security: RFID vehicular booms, 24/7 CCTV surveillance, and dedicated rapid-response security patrols.

## Real Estate Investor Metrics
- Gross Rental Yield: 4.8% - 5.6%
- Average Occupancy Rate: 98%+ driven by on-campus Blue Ridge SEZ (35,000+ tech workforce)
- Capital Appreciation: 12% - 15% annualized trend driven by Metro Line 3 and Balewadi-Mahalunge connectivity.
